newsitem.title: UK: LCE cocoa closes around day's highs - SEPT 12.
newsitem.headline: LCE cocoa closes around day's highs - SEPT 12.

text.p: London cocoa futures moved steadily higher throughout the afternoon as the market tracked a similar trend in New York futures.
December ended at 985 stg, up 14 stg a tonne from Wednesday and just one stg under the day's high. Turnover was 4,064 lots

Traders said the market was overdue a technical bounce and that, apart from a higher New York market, various recent estimates of a sizeable physical cocoa deficit in 1996/97 was probably making sellers a little wary.

Earlier in the day UK commodity house E.D & F Man revised its 1995/96 surplus estimate to 36,000 from 2,000 tonnes but the market was waiting for Man to come out with a specific figure for 1996/97 following sizeable deficit estimates recently from Landell Mills, Cargill and the ICCO.
